name_input: ASSOCIATED ELECTROCHEMICALS PVT. LTD.; Associated Electrochemicals Private Limited
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug associated-electrochemicals-private-limited): "2026-02-19 | ASSOCIATED ELECTROCHEMICALS PRIVATE LIMITED | TO ORDER | BATTERY SEPARATOR (LEAF TYPE WITH GM) (API) | PETRAPOLE INPTPB, India | BENAPOLE, Bangladesh | 85079010 | 9822861" — an actual outbound export record with date, destination, HS code and B/L number. Second export row on same page: "2026-02-26 | ASSOCIATED ELECTROCHEMICALS PRIVATE LIMITED | METAL MANUFACTURING NIGERIA LTD. | BATTERY SEPARATOR (PE-ROLLFORM) | MUNDRA SEA INMUN1, India | Apapa, Nigeria | 85079090 | 1051125". Buyer-side export counterparties listed on the same page include STC ENERGY INDUSTRIES PVT LTD (Birgunj, Nepal, 259 shipments), ASIAN BATTERIES PVT.LTD. (Biratnagar, Nepal, 121), LEADER KAIJIE BATTERY (Colombo, Sri Lanka, 26), DALLON PLASTICOS LIMITADA (Rolandia, Brazil, 16). Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 1530 Records detected", "Trading Partners 33", "Ports 57", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-26"; rows actually visible to me in the free view: 5 shipment rows (2 outbound export + 3 inbound import), i.e. 5 of 1530 — the 1530 figure is the platform's counter, not a count I verified.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract document was retrieved. The only domestic-market trace is indirect: the same ImportKey page lists Indian buyers/suppliers of battery-separator material, e.g. "2904 IRPC PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED | AMBICA CORPORATION LIMITED, A DONG ADG CORPORATION, EVEREADY INDUSTRIES INDIA LTD, PROCON ENGINEERING PVT LTD, ASSOCIATED ELECTROCHEMICALS PRIVATE LIMITED" and "371 KPIC CORPORATION | DARAMIC BATTERY SEPARATOR INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, ASSOCIATED ELECTROCHEMICALS PRIVATE LIMITED, XPRO INDIA LIMITED" — these are import-consignment co-listing lines, not proof of domestic sales. Registered address on the alternate page: "PLOT NO. 172, HSIICD, INDUSTRIAL AREA, SECTOR-6, BHADURGARH, HARYANA, CIN NO. U25200DL2010PTC211059**" (CIN as printed on the source page, unverified against MCA).
note: Export side is factually confirmed: real customs export entries with dates (2026-02-19, 2026-02-26), destinations (Bangladesh, Nigeria), HS 85079010 / 85079090 and B/L numbers 9822861 / 1051125, plus Nepal/Sri Lanka/Brazil buyer lanes. Declared HS 450390 (cork/cork articles) does not match the actual traded product — battery separators of polyethylene/PE, HS 8507.90 — so the code should be corrected to 8507.90; per project rules this is not a rejection ground. Note the company is dual-role: it also imports heavily (PE powder from IRPC Thailand, modacrylic tow from Japan, machinery from Cowell Nanjing), i.e. manufacturer_trader profile. Domestic supply evidence is weak: no GST turnover, GeM/CPPP tender or contract found, so domestic_status is declared_only, not confirmed. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null — not public in the free views. Search tool (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down for this session (connection refused) and volza/eximpedia returned HTTP 403, so cross-checking was limited to two ImportKey company pages (associated-electrochemicals-private-limited and associated-electrochemicals-pvt-ltd), which are consistent with each other.
